tests.name: compile returns test and exec, and exec reports the leftmost match
dot matches any single character except newline
star is greedy and takes everything it can
a*a backtracks: the star gives characters back until the final a matches
plus requires at least one repetition and backtracks greedily
question matches zero or one, greedily taking the one
character classes match listed characters and inclusive ranges
negated classes match anything not listed, including newline
a dash is a literal at the start or end of a class, and escapes work inside classes
anchors ^ and $ pin the match to the whole subject and are zero-width
alternation combined with anchors resolves per the backtracking order
groups capture text and number by opening parens, inner after outer
groups that do not participate in the match capture undefined
quantified groups capture the last completed repetition
an empty iteration is not taken once the quantifier minimum is satisfied
alternation tries alternatives left to right and empty alternatives are allowed
backslash escapes metacharacters to literals
invalid patterns throw TypeError with the exact prefixed messages
matchCount counts non-overlapping matches, resuming at each match end
matchCount advances one character past an empty match instead of looping
non-string subjects throw TypeError with the exact message
combined constructs: leftmost wins, greedy mixed quantifiers, escapes with classes
